built_by: Local build of Dockerfile.service from the checked-out revision, pushed to the Fly registry and deployed by digest
what_this_release_changes: The service serves the independently reviewed starter catalogue from the release image instead of the single diagnostic record that release 8 carried. The 43 approved bodies and the generated host manifest are copied to /opt/baltor/catalogue, owned by the unprivileged service user and read only. The catalogue travels in the image, not on the storage volume, because a volume holds state and this is release content.

catalogue.decision_rule: An item is approved only when every independent reviewer approves it. One written objection withholds approval and leaves the item a candidate.
catalogue.generated_by: tools/build_host_catalogue_manifest.py, which refuses any item a reviewer rejected and any licence the host policy does not accept

continuous_integration.note: The release rule in AGENTS.md asks for a committed revision whose continuous integration run passed. Revision 81f341d was committed locally and deployed without being pushed, so no run judged it. This is recorded as a departure from the rule, not as a passing run. The local equivalents of the gates were run instead and are listed under local_verification.

local_verification.tools_regression_suite: PYTHONPATH=src:tools python -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py', 491 of 491
local_verification.hardcoding_delta_gate: exit 0 with devtools/hardcoding-allowlist.yaml and devtools/hardcoding-ci-baseline.json at --fail-on-new high
local_verification.container_check: tools/check_fly_service_container.py against the deployed digest, 14 of 14 container checks and 232 of 232 installed service checks

before_release.volume_state: created, 1GB, iad, encrypted, attached to machine 83733ea7779068

cases.case: a manifest naming an item whose body was changed after the digest was computed
cases.code: artifact_size_mismatch when the change alters the byte count, artifact_digest_mismatch when it does not

cases.case: a manifest naming an item that a reviewer rejected
cases.refused_by: the generator, which never writes the row

cases.case: a manifest with a body path that escapes the artifact root
an item whose licence the host policy does not accept
cases.refused_by: the host before registration, and the generator before it writes

rollback.note: Fly releases v8, v9 and v10 all carry the release 8 image, so a rollback by digest returns the service to the catalogue state that release 8 served.

limits: No continuous integration run judged the deployed revision. The local gates were run instead and are listed above.

The branch release/catalogue-live is one commit from an older main. While this release was prepared, main grew the same starter catalogue from 49 bodies to 123 and split its specification file into three. The 74 added candidates carry no review record, so none of them is approved and none is served. Reconciling the branch with main, and reviewing those candidates independently, is required work and is not done here.
Offered and served are separate facts. 34 of the 43 approved items are offered to the pilot owner; 9 are withheld because they declare effects the requesting step holds no authority for.
No customer journey is qualified by this release.
